chapters.reason: RetNet introduces a retention mechanism that uses a matrix-valued hidden state with predetermined decay and update rules, fitting the definition of linear-state recurrence.
The paper focuses on efficient long-sequence modeling and constant-memory inference, which aligns with the goals of compressive memory architectures like Infini-attention.
The paper proposes RetNet as a successor to Transformer, effectively replacing the quadratic self-attention mechanism with a sub-quadratic, recurrent-capable architecture.
